description: Append-only, cross-session log of real per-batch execution cost, seeded to let scripts/learning_curve_report.py fit a Wright's-Law-style power-law curve (cost(n) = a * n^(-b)) once enough comparable data exists. Distinct from execution-ledger.json (per-case PASS/FAIL outcomes) -- this tracks throughput/cost trend across sequential batches within and across sessions, tagged with session_id so a genuinely durable improvement (tooling, established convention) can eventually be distinguished from a session-bound prompt-cache effect once a second session's data exists. Append only; never edit or delete an existing row.
